original:
Lemma 5.

Let $G$ be a graph, $e\in E(G),$ and $P(e)$ and $S(e)$ be the parallel and series class of $e$ with $|P(e)|=p$ and $|S(e)|=s.$ Then:

(c) 

if $S(e)$ is a subdivided loop, then

 $T_{G}(0,2)=2T_{G-S(e)}(0,2)\qquad\text{and}\qquad T_{G}(1,1)=sT_{G-S(e)}(1,1),$

(d) 

if $S(e)$ is not a subdivided loop, then

 $T_{G}(0,2)=T_{G-S(e)}(0,2)+T_{G/S(e)}(0,2)\quad\text{and}$ 

 $T_{G}(1,1)=sT_{G-S(e)}(1,1)+T_{G/S(e)}(1,1).\qquad$
